title: SI No. 4 of 2025 Towns Property Evaluation (Belize City Council) Incentive Program) Order, 2025
text:
Towns Property Evaluation
BELIZE:
TOWNS PROPERTY EVALUATION (BELIZE CITY COUNCIL)
(INCENTIVE PROGRAM) ORDER, 2025.
ARRANGEMENT OF ORDER
1. Citation.
2. Interpretation.
3. Declaration of Rates Discount.
4. Conditions.

No. 4] Towns Property Evaluation 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 4 of 2025
____________
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for Local
Government in exercise of the powers conferred upon
him by section 18A(5) of the Towns Property Evaluation
Act, Chapter 65 of the Substantive Laws of Belize,
Revised Edition 2020, and all other powers thereunto
him enabling.
(Gazetted 11th January, 2025)
____________
1. This Order may be cited as the
Citation.
TOWNS PROPERTY EVALUATION (BELIZE CITY
COUNCIL) (INCENTIVE PROGRAM) ORDER 2025.
2. In this Order “senior citizen” means a person who has Interpretation.
attained the age of sixty-five years and who is, or entitled to
be, a holder of a Social Security Golden Citizen Card.
3. Subject to paragraph 4, rates of discount applicable to
Declaration of
rates of property fee payable to the Belize City Council in Rates of
Discount.
the financial year commencing on 1 April 2025 and ending
on 31 March 2026, and the applicable categories are declared
as follows:
Category Rate of Discount
(a) Senior Citizens 35%
(b) Early Payment 15%, 10% or 5%
(c) Arrears 20%

2 Towns Property Evaluation [No. 4
Conditions. 4. The following conditions apply to the rates of discount
declared under paragraph 3–
(a) in relation to a person within category (a), 35% if
the person resides on the property and full payment
is made during the fi nancial year; and
(b) in relation to a person within category (b)–
(i) 25% if payment is made during the period
beginning on 1 September 2024 and ending
on 31 December 2024;
(ii) 15% if payment is made during the month
of January 2025;
(iii) 10% if payment is made during the month
of February 2025;
(iv) 5% if payment is made during the month of
March 2025;
(c) in relation to a person within category (c), 20%
on all arrears if payment is made on 18 October
2025;
(d) the rates declared in paragraph (b) shall apply to a
person within category (a) in addition to the rate
declared in paragraph (a).
MADE by the Minister responsible for Local Government
this 10th day of January, 2025.
(HON. OSCAR REQUEÑA)
Minister of Rural Transformation, Community Development,
Local Government and Labour
(Minister responsible for local government)
